summary: Second pass over the candidates left behind the first-pass cap in chapters 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12 and 13. 45 records added after independent review and blind significance scoring: chapter 06 eight (c06-20 to c06-27), chapter 07 two (c07-20, c07-21), chapter 10 one (c10-17), chapter 11 twelve (c11-23 to c11-34), chapter 12 thirteen (c12-22 to c12-34) and chapter 13 nine (c13-22 to c13-30). Chapters 08 and 09 yielded no record: their leftovers are internal practices, items covered by existing records, or items overtaken by the USAID wind-down. None dropped in review; review lowered 12 stages from the drafts. Stages of the new records: 16 proposed, 15 in progress, 11 no action found, 2 diverged, 1 implemented. Reverse cross-references added on 54 existing records; the chapter field of 19 records written on 2026-10-14 normalized to two digits. The counted set is now 526. About 161 of 190 searches used.
title: Layer 3 second pass: chapters 06 to 13 leftover candidates
